root_cause.text: The `hci_le_create_big_complete_evt` function fails to validate that the iteration index `i` remains within the bounds of `ev->num_bis` before accessing the `bis_handle` array, allowing out-of-bounds memory reads when the controller provides fewer handles than expected.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states "there is no check that i stays within ev->num_bis before the array access," and the patch fixes this by adding `if (ev->num_bis <= i)` to prevent reading beyond the valid `bis_handle[]` flex array and terminating the BIG if setup fails.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: In the `hci_le_create_big_complete_evt` function, the absence of a bounds check comparing the iteration index `i` against `ev->num_bis` before accessing `ev->bis_handle` allows out-of-bounds memory reads when the controller provides fewer BIS handles than expected, triggering an infinite loop.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch inserts `if (ev->num_bis <= i)` before the array access `ev->bis_handle[i++]`, correcting the CVE description's assertion that "there is no check that i stays within ev->num_bis before the array access."

vuln_statements.explanation: This loop iterates using 'i' as an index to access bis_handle array elements without validating that 'i' stays within bounds of ev->num_bis. When the controller provides more handles than expected (le_conn->num_bis > ev->num_bis), the subsequent bis_handle[i] access causes out-of-bounds memory read.

This statement accesses bis_handle array using unchecked index 'i'. Combined with the unbounded loop condition, it allows reading beyond the allocated ev->num_bis array bounds when controller reports more BIS handles than configured.
